description: This file implements a login page component for a web application, featuring a two-step login flow: first collecting email to fetch user organizations, then allowing the user to select an organization or input one manually, and finally submitting login credentials. It manages state, handles API calls, and performs navigation upon successful login.

methods.name: handleFetchOrgs
methods.description: Handles fetching user organizations based on email input, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles the login process, including validation, API call, error handling, and navigation.
